market.headline: An early pop on Anthropic's IPO failed and stocks closed at the day's lows: SPY fell 2.0% to 715.87 and QQQ fell 2.2% to 645.04, with the VIX at 25.46 and the 10-year yield at 5.1%.
market.day_type: Failed rally that became a broad selloff. Money rushed into AI on the IPO at the open, then rising yields, Fed minutes that lean toward more hikes, and new China chip curbs pushed sellers in all day, on 1.4x normal volume in SPY.
watch: The first hour on Friday: SPY 715.65 and QQQ 644.34 are today's lows and the 20-day lows. A break below them means the selloff is still running.
AMD's reply to the short-seller report, and any news on new US export blacklist names. Both hit the whole chip group.
Nov 25 at 08:30: GDP and PCE inflation. With the 10-year at 5.1%, a hot inflation number keeps pressure on tech.

stocks.headline: Fell 7.7% to 489.19 on 1.9x volume after a short-seller said its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. It fell another 1.9% after hours to 479.7.
stocks.why: This was a news-driven drop, not a business drop. Sales are up 45% and growing faster, profit per share is up 74%, and analysts raised next year's estimates 15% in 90 days. The risk is legal, not about demand. If the claim leads to an export probe, data center sales to some buyers get frozen, and the stock trades on headlines rather than earnings until then. The story fits the same theme as TSMC's China shipment halt, so NVDA, TSM, ARM and SMCI take the same hit to sentiment.

long_term.reason: The business is among the strongest here, but the stock still costs 114x last year's profit. Until AMD answers the China claim, the downside has no clear floor. This matches the house view.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A clear denial or a clean regulatory answer while the stock holds 470.56 makes it a buy on dips. A formal probe makes it an Avoid.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open. Buy nothing until AMD responds and the stock closes back above 513.7. If it trades below 470.56, stay out completely.

levels.means: Today's low. Above = the panic has a floor. Below = selling resumes toward 428.63.

stocks.headline: Morning call: right.
stocks.why: The numbers are not the problem. Sales are up 106%, the outlook was in line, estimates are up 27% in 90 days, and it trades at 9x next year's profit. Three things are pressing on it: the CEO's exit, TSMC and Samsung halting some chip shipments to Chinese customers, and the Anthropic IPO pulling AI money toward a new name. A cheap stock with a leadership hole and a China problem can keep getting cheaper until one of those clears. If it keeps falling, MU, TSM, SMCI and the whole QQQ go with it.

long_term.reason: It earns huge profits at a low price, but there's no permanent CEO and the China rules are still changing. Holding is right. Adding before either clears is early. This matches the house view.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A permanent CEO plus a close back above 156.14 turns this into Add on dips. A guidance cut tied to China turns it into Wait.
stocks.action: Holders keep their shares. No new money tomorrow. Buy a first small piece only on a close back above 156.14.

levels.means: Above = sellers are running out. Below = no support nearby, and after hours (144.69) already points there.
The close before the report. Above = the post-report damage is repaired. Below = still in a downtrend.
Today's high. Above = the selloff is over in the short term.

stocks.headline: Morning call: right.
stocks.why: Google is a big infrastructure partner of Anthropic, so the IPO first read as good news. Sellers used that pop to get out, which shows how weak demand for the stock is. The stock is cheap at 15x profit, its lowest in five years, with a large contracted backlog. But profit per share fell 26% last quarter and it missed forecasts by 30%, because AI spending is growing faster than sales. AMZN, the other big Anthropic partner, faded the same way.

long_term.reason: The valuation is low for a reason: costs are outrunning sales and estimates are not rising. Wait for proof that the spending pays off. This matches the house view.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A close back above 284.97 shows buyers are back. A close below 270.0 means the bottom isn't in.
stocks.action: No buys tomorrow. If it closes below 270.0, stay out. Put it on the buy list only after a close above 284.97.
